positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Design, development, integration and testing of video processing software in an embedded MTS camera system. Including hands-on integration, troubleshooting, and testing at each system level: requirement/use-case development, software unit testing, in-plant system integration, as well as off-site testing and integration for customer delivery, and remote troubleshooting post-delivery.
